article_title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms sparks fears of AI slowdown

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central explanation for the global tech sell-off?
options: Election results increased fears of tighter limits on AI and data-centre growth, adding to doubts about whether heavy AI investment will pay off.
A single chip factory closed permanently in Japan.
Investors learned that artificial intelligence had been banned worldwide.
US companies announced that they would stop selling technology in Asia.
tasks.correct_answer: Election results increased fears of tighter limits on AI and data-centre growth, adding to doubts about whether heavy AI investment will pay off.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שתוצאות בחירות האמצע הגבירו חשש להגבלות על AI ומרכזי נתונים, על רקע ספקות קיימים לגבי החזר ההשקעות העצומות.

tasks.prompt: What happened to the Nasdaq Composite?
options: It rose by more than 12%.
It closed more than 5.5% lower and lost an estimated $2.5tn in market value.
It stopped publishing technology prices.
It was unaffected by the sell-off.
tasks.correct_answer: It closed more than 5.5% lower and lost an estimated $2.5tn in market value.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מדד נאסד"ק ירד ביותר מ־5.5%, ולפי נתוני Dow Jones איבד שווי שוק מוערך של 2.5 טריליון דולר.

tasks.prompt: What is a “circuit breaker” in stock-market trading?
options: A computer chip used in data centres
A tax on semiconductor companies
A mechanism that temporarily halts trading to reduce panic selling
A rule that permanently closes an exchange
tasks.correct_answer: A mechanism that temporarily halts trading to reduce panic selling
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Circuit breaker הוא מנגנון שעוצר זמנית את המסחר כדי לצמצם מכירות בהלה.

tasks.prompt: What political change followed the US midterm elections?
options: Republicans gained control of every state government.
The president cancelled all election results.
Congress abolished data-centre regulation.
Democrats won both the Senate and House, taking control of Congress.
tasks.correct_answer: Democrats won both the Senate and House, taking control of Congress.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הדמוקרטים זכו גם בסנאט וגם בבית הנבחרים וקיבלו שליטה בקונגרס.

tasks.prompt: How much market value did Nvidia lose as its shares fell more than 9%?
options: More than $400bn
About $2.5m
Exactly $45m
Less than $1bn
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ירידה של יותר מ־9% במניית Nvidia מחקה יותר מ־400 מיליארד דולר משווי השוק שלה.

options: An index has reached a record high.
An exchange has corrected a data error.
A company has changed its accounting rules.
An index or company value is at least 10% below its recent high.
tasks.correct_answer: An index or company value is at least 10% below its recent high.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Correction territory מתאר מצב שבו מדד או שווי חברה נמוכים לפחות ב־10% מהשיא האחרון.

tasks.prompt: Give three examples showing that the sell-off spread beyond US technology stocks.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש דוגמאות מדויקות משווקים או חברות מחוץ לארה"ב.
expected_points: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell about 6%, with Kioxia and Tokyo Electron dropping sharply.
South Korea's Kospi fell more than 8.5%, triggering a circuit breaker.
SK Hynix and Samsung suffered large falls.
Taiwan's Taiex dropped more than 8.3%, while TSMC fell nearly 8.5%.
European firms Infineon and ASML also fell sharply.

tasks.prompt: Why did the midterm results intensify concerns that had already existed about AI companies?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב בין חששות כלכליים קיימים לבין הסיכון הפוליטי החדש.
expected_points: Investors were already questioning whether massive AI infrastructure spending would produce adequate returns.
Democratic candidates campaigned on slowing data-centre and AI growth.
New congressional control could bring more oversight and restrictions.
Restrictions or slower approvals could delay projects and raise costs.
The combination increased fear that highly valued AI shares may be in a bubble.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the market rout, its political trigger and the underlying AI concerns in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את ירידות השוק, תוצאות הבחירות, מרכזי הנתונים, התפשטות גל המכירות וספק ההחזר הכלכלי.
expected_points: Major US technology shares fell sharply after Democratic midterm victories raised expectations of stronger AI and data-centre oversight.
The Nasdaq lost more than 5.5%, while chipmakers and other AI-exposed firms suffered particularly large falls.
The sell-off spread to Asian and European markets.
Investors were already worried that enormous infrastructure spending might not generate expected returns.
Greater scrutiny of environmental and electricity impacts could slow construction and increase industry costs.

tasks.prompt: Write a short investor-risk briefing based on the article without giving investment advice.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג גורמי סיכון ועובדות מאוזנות, ללא תחזית ודאית או המלצת קנייה ומכירה.
expected_points: Identify political and regulatory risk after the midterm results.
Mention concern about returns on AI infrastructure spending.
Note the exposure of chipmakers, data-centre suppliers and major technology firms.
Explain that market falls spread across regions and indexes.
Distinguish observed losses from uncertain future outcomes.
